critique.good: 特徴列を広げたことでr0Aより文章の流れが改善し、行間の移動も短くなった。性能と価格は一行で比較でき、3案の中では最もバランスがよい。

critique.good: 機種列が広く、日立や東芝などはメーカー名と型番を一行で読み取れる。性能と価格も一行に収まる。

critique.good: r1Aより機種列が広く、三菱電機などの型番がまとまって見える。性能値と価格は1行で保たれている。

understanding.purpose: 500Lクラスの冷蔵庫6機種を、性能、税込価格、特徴から比較し、購入候補を絞るための表。
understanding.reading: 機種名で行を追いながら、消費電力・容量・騒音を縦に比較し、価格と特徴を照らし合わせる。説明文の折り返しで生じる行高を、機種名や見出しの折り返しにも使える。
groups: 消費電力・容量・騒音は、共通見出し「性能」の下で機種間を比較する数値列。
機種名と特徴は各行の製品を識別し、その個性を説明する列。
価格は性能や特徴と並べて購入判断に使う独立した比較列。
keep_intact: 型番の英数字とハイフン
消費電力・容量・騒音の数値と単位
may_wrap: メーカー名と型番の間
必要に応じて列見出し

bad.why: Several prices separate the 円 symbol from the amount, making a key comparison column harder to scan.

final.rationale: r3C keeps the performance values and prices on single lines while giving the long descriptions enough width for a relatively even row rhythm. The performance group remains easy to scan across, and the descriptions are less vertically stretched than in the narrower alternatives. Some model identifiers wrap at hyphens, but their bold row headers remain identifiable.

general: Give comparison values enough width to keep amounts and units together.
Allocate width according to each column’s role and content; long prose and short measurements have different needs.
Judge row height alongside the readability of row labels and the relationships among columns.
specific: Here, a small reduction in price width separates 円 from several amounts.
The description column drives nearly all row heights, so a few pixels transferred to it noticeably change the table’s rhythm.

final.tradeoffs: r2A and r3A give model names more room, at the cost of narrower descriptions and taller rows. r3B gives the first model a cleaner two-line label, but wraps the description header and makes the prose narrower.
final.uncertain: The ranges are deliberately limited to the tested preferred widths: nearby widths may be equally good, but the supplied renders do not establish their boundaries. A designer who prioritizes model identifiers over description rhythm might prefer r2A or r3A.

A.why: Performance values and prices stay on one line, and the description has a comparatively readable measure. Several model names and the price header wrap, while the long descriptions make rows tall.

B.why: The wider model column keeps some identifiers intact, and the performance values and prices scan cleanly. The narrower description column produces more wrapping and taller rows.

C.why: Models have a little more room and numerical values stay intact, but both the price and description headers wrap. The narrow descriptions create tall rows and large empty areas beneath the numbers.

D.why: The description has a reasonable measure and performance values remain intact, but several prices separate the yen symbol from the amount, making comparison less immediate.

E.why: Descriptions read comfortably, but the performance columns are too narrow: headers break into stacked characters, and values separate from their units. Prices also wrap, undermining comparison.

F.why: The description is squeezed into a very narrow column, producing extremely tall rows and extensive empty space elsewhere. Energy values also wrap, while model identifiers and headers break across lines.

reviews.unsure: A and B are close: B preserves more model identifiers, while A gives the lengthy descriptions more room and improves the overall row rhythm.

A.why: 性能値と価格は一行で比較しやすいが、特徴欄が狭く、説明の折り返しが多い。機種名や価格・特徴の見出しも折り返される。

B.why: 特徴欄は読みやすい幅だが、性能の見出しと数値・単位が細切れになり、価格も円が別行に落ちるため、機種間の比較がしにくい。

C.why: 性能値と価格が一行に収まり、特徴欄にも比較的幅がある。ただし機種欄が狭く、MR-WX52Kなどの型番が分断される。

D.why: 性能値は一行で比較でき、特徴欄も比較的広いが、一部の価格で円が次行に落ち、型番にも分断がある。

E.why: 特徴欄が極端に狭く、説明が短い断片に折り返されて行が非常に高い。消費電力の単位も分断され、他列には大きな空白が生じる。

F.why: 性能値と価格が一行に収まり、多くの型番もまとまっている。特徴欄はやや狭く、説明の折り返しと行内の空白が目立つ。

reviews.unsure: Cは特徴欄がやや広く、説明の読みやすさを重視する場合は有力。Fも一部の型番や価格見出しが折り返され、どちらも長い説明によって行が高くなる。
